title: Cosmic Time Cauldron
description: A large ornate cauldron floats in a cosmic void, glowing with golden light from within as blue liquid drips from its rim. Below it, three hooded spectral figures with clock faces for heads rise from swirling blue energy, surrounded by floating books, gears, hourglasses, and three celestial orbs in the starry sky above.
prompt: A surreal cosmic scene featuring a large ornate metallic cauldron floating in a starry nebula, glowing with golden light inside and dripping blue liquid from its rim. Below are three ethereal hooded figures with clock faces instead of heads, emerging from swirling blue energy. Floating around them are open books with pages turning, gears, hourglasses, and envelopes. In the upper sky, three celestial orbs resembling moon phases glow in a beam of light against a dark blue and purple nebula background.
